title: Infrastructure Automation
description: Go deeper into CloudFormation, CDK, and Terraform for infrastructure as code. Learn advanced IaC patterns.
longDescription: This module covers advanced infrastructure as code (IaC) tools and patterns. You will learn how to write advanced CloudFormation templates with nested stacks, build reusable infrastructure with AWS CDK, manage AWS infrastructure with Terraform, and apply IaC best practices for teams.
whatYouLearn: Write advanced CloudFormation templates with nested stacks
Build reusable infrastructure with AWS CDK
Apply IaC best practices for teams
